警視廳統計書 1942

Keishichō tōkeisho (Statistical Report of the Metropolitan Police Board), 第52回, 昭和17年 (1942)
警視廳 (Metropolitan Police Board), 東京, 1944 (昭和19年刊行)

All 198 numbered tables are transcribed; the printed contents are given as the table of contents, and the chapter dividers are not reproduced. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from full-resolution crops, with no checking by eye; the cells left unreadable in the three tables with more than four of them were read again blind (without the first reading or the totals) by Claude Opus 5.5. The scan is dark and blotted in places, and station names in heavy type were sometimes read from the same station list in neighbouring tables (noted where so). Where a 3 could be an 8 and only one reading makes the printed total reconcile — the cell being the only doubtful one in that sum — that reading is used and noted. Printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. 92 of about 193,000 filled cells could not be read and are marked [?].
